title: Rosalind and the Contact
author: Felix Sandoval
blurb: Silas Quintana, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
